pairs.ask: Recommended Tier Emphasis: Keep Plus As Recommended, Or Soften The Flag?

optionA.label: Keep Plus Recommended
optionA.desc: Compromise effect: middle option often wins (~57% in classic camera study).

optionB.label: Soften The Flag
optionB.desc: Let price and visits sell; less nudge.

pairs.ask: Complete Vs Plus Gap: Complete Is About 1.9x Plus ($312 vs $164). Narrow The Gap, Or Keep It?

optionA.label: Keep The Gap
optionA.desc: Complete stays premium for monthly-visit buyers.

optionB.label: Narrow Toward 1.4x
optionB.desc: May lift Complete share closer to ~21% camera-study top option.

pairs.ask: Essentials Floor: Hold $99/mo From Price, Or Raise For Metro Detroit Cost?

optionA.label: Hold $99 From
optionA.desc: Conservative; matches draft pricing-config on the box.

optionB.label: Raise The Floor
optionB.desc: Typical 2-3k sq ft homes quote higher than From.

pairs.ask: Tier Mix Planning Assumption: Use Base Mix (30/55/15) Or Conservative (45/45/10)?

optionA.label: Base 30/55/15
optionA.desc: Blended tier about $167/mo in the Oct 14 forecast.

optionB.label: Conservative 45/45/10
optionB.desc: Blended about $150/mo; safer cash model.

pairs.ask: Lawn Mowing As Add-On: Keep As Top A La Carte, Or Bundle Into Plus?

optionA.label: Keep A La Carte
optionA.desc: Detroit avg about $52.90/cut (LawnStarter); Max draft ~$40 for 3-5k sq ft.

optionB.label: Bundle Into Plus
optionB.desc: Higher Plus price; stickier annual.

pairs.ask: Snow Removal: Offer Seasonal Add-On (~$1,595 Oakland examples), Or Partner-Referral Only?

optionA.label: Seasonal Add-On
optionA.desc: Covers lawn off-season; largest ticket; lower margin if subcontracted.

optionB.label: Referral Only
optionB.desc: Less risk; less revenue per member.

pairs.ask: Leaf And Fall Cleanup: Add To Menu (Detroit avg ~$259 Angi), Or Skip For Beta?

optionA.label: Add To Menu
optionA.desc: Natural bundle with mowing; LawnStarter notes leaf attach on Detroit lawns.

optionB.label: Skip For Beta
optionB.desc: Fewer SKUs while friends-and-family runs.

pairs.ask: Window Washing Attach: Push As Easy High-Margin Add-On (avg ~$221 Angi), Or Quiet Upsell?

optionA.label: Feature It On Extras
optionA.desc: Easy, one or two visits a year.

optionB.label: Quiet Upsell On Visit Day
optionB.desc: Less page clutter.

pairs.ask: Pressure Washing: Menu Tile (avg ~$312 Angi), Or On-Request Only?

optionA.label: Menu Tile
optionA.desc: Can share visit days; forecast modeled 5-15% attach.

optionB.label: On-Request Only
optionB.desc: Keeps the Extras list shorter.

pairs.ask: Pest Control Quarterly: Partner Add-On (~$800/yr draft), Or Out Of Scope For Launch?

optionA.label: Partner Add-On
optionA.desc: Recurring; done by a partner; Angi $100-$300/visit band.

optionB.label: Out Of Scope For Launch
optionB.desc: Focus HVAC, gutters, irrigation already in tiers.

pairs.ask: Welcome Offer Pay-24-Get-30: Keep, Or Drop To Protect Cash?

optionA.label: Keep The Offer
optionA.desc: Cuts revenue per service-month ~20% for takers; strong close.

optionB.label: Drop For Launch
optionB.desc: Cleaner unit economics while learning attach rates.

pairs.ask: Renewal Ops: Call Before Renewal (70-85% HVAC band), Or Email Only (40-55%)?

optionA.label: Call Before Renewal
optionA.desc: Service Roundtable/NCI/ACCA retention band favors calls.

optionB.label: Email Only At First
optionB.desc: Cheaper; expect lower renewal.

pairs.ask: Renewal KPI Bar: Track Against ~80% (Frontdoor-style), Or Set A Lower Internal Bar?

optionA.label: Track Against ~80%
optionA.desc: Gives UpKeep a clear dashboard number.

optionB.label: Start At 60% Internal
optionB.desc: Closer to industry average 55-65% until process matures.

pairs.ask: Failed Card Recovery: Stripe Smart Retries From Day One (docs cite ~55% recovery), Or Manual Follow-Up?

optionA.label: Smart Retries From Day One
optionA.desc: Pause scheduling while recovering; do not silent-cancel.

optionB.label: Manual Follow-Up
optionB.desc: Fine at tiny beta volume.

pairs.ask: Gutters And HVAC For Non-Members: Sell A La Carte At Angi/MI Bands, Or Members Only?

optionA.label: A La Carte To Non-Members
optionA.desc: Gutter clean $180-$360 2-story; furnace tune-up $129-$159 MI examples.

optionB.label: Members Only
optionB.desc: Protects membership value.

pairs.ask: Average Member Spend Model: Plan Cash On Base ~$228/mo, Or Conservative ~$189/mo?

optionA.label: Base ~$228/mo
optionA.desc: Tier blend + add-on attach from Oct 14 forecast.

optionB.label: Conservative ~$189/mo
optionB.desc: Safer until beta attach rates replace assumptions.

pairs.ask: Share This Forecast With UpKeep Now, Or Hold For An Edit Pass First?

optionA.label: Send To UpKeep Now
optionA.desc: They own pricing on smartupkeep.ai; research is ready.

optionB.label: Hold For Edit
optionB.desc: Tighten assumptions before it hits their board.

pairs.ask: Lawn Season Cash: Show Members A Seasonal Calendar, Or Annualize Only On The Price Page?

optionA.label: Show Seasonal Calendar
optionA.desc: Apr-Oct lawn ~26 cuts; Nov-Mar snow; cash is lumpy.

optionB.label: Annualize Only
optionB.desc: Simpler price page; less sticker shock month to month.

pairs.ask: Competitor Price Anchors On Page: Monty $19-$150 And Upkeepers From $59, Or No Competitor Prices?

optionA.label: Show Anchors
optionA.desc: Context for $99/$164/$312 From prices.

optionB.label: No Competitor Prices
optionB.desc: Avoid training buyers to shop the bottom.

pairs.ask: Attach-Rate Logging: Treat App Add-On Events As Source Of Truth, Or Keep Research Assumptions Until 50 Members?

optionA.label: App Events As Truth
optionA.desc: Forecast says replace assumptions with beta data.

optionB.label: Assumptions Until 50
optionB.desc: Too noisy early; revisit at 50 members.
